release_notes.en-US: Reduces false warnings on legitimate Google, cloud infrastructure, filenames, versions, dates, and other dotted text. Improves detection of misleading domains, shared-hosting boundaries, Unicode brand lookalikes, accessibility labels, dynamically added links, and subframe links. Warning labels remain isolated from conflicting webpage CSS.

version.approval_notes: Version 0.1.2 improves deterministic link analysis to reduce both false positives and false negatives. It adds token-aware brand matching, selected Unicode confusable handling, stronger visible-domain parsing, common country-code and shared-hosting boundaries, accessibility label analysis, MutationObserver rescans, open Shadow DOM scanning, and matching subframe injection. The all_frames and match_about_blank content-script settings add no new permission. Analysis remains entirely on-device with no remote requests, telemetry, accounts, or external services, and the declared data collection remains none. The supplied 150-case regression fixture passed in headless Firefox ESR 140, all automated tests passed, and Mozilla lint reported no errors, warnings, or notices before submission.
